_comment: This is not a policy document to attach to the role. It's the shape of the resource-based (Lambda-side) permission that Bedrock needs. In Style 1, attaching this Lambda to an Orchestrator Agent's Action Group via the console/CLI typically adds this automatically. If you ever need to add it manually, use the `aws lambda add-permission` command below with your own values filled in.
cli_example: aws lambda add-permission --function-name current-weather-lambda --statement-id AllowBedrockAgentInvoke --action lambda:InvokeFunction --principal bedrock.amazonaws.com --source-arn arn:aws:bedrock:<REGION>:<ACCOUNT_ID>:agent/<AGENT_ID>
